title: $10M Bonds for Elysium Grand Apartments
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing and Finance Corporation held a public hearing.
*   The hearing focused on approving the issuance of up to $10 million in private activity bonds.
*   These bonds are intended to help finance the Elysium Grand Apartments project, located at 3300 Oak Creek Drive in District 7.
